name: Tomoe Kyoko
source:
Next in line to be the head of her family, Kyoko comes from a long line of women warriors known as much for their fierceness as their grace in battle. Despite her small stature, she is truly a force to be reckoned with. She is the highest ranking of the group aside from the Magistrates, and many people call her “Princess” Kyoko. She will not tolerate disrespect.

Due to her responsibilities within her own family, Kyoko is not considered a serious candidate for magistrate. Even so, being asked to partake in this journey was a great honor she
could not refuse. She views it as an chance not only to test her mettle, but an opportunity to fulfill one of her biggest obligations to her family: finding a husband so that she can
produce an heir!

Her horse is Ikazuchi Kasai, a mighty stallion. Legend has it that he is descended from a horse given to her ancestor by the Emperor himself.

[From [url=http://hub.leadingscientistsgames.com/about/characters/tomoe-kyoko/]official site[/url]]
